title: Corporation aims to boost MSU sports revenue. Should it operate in secret?
summary_en: MSU’s secrecy around Spartan Media Ventures, a new for-profit corporation formed to raise money for sports programs, has some concerned — including members of the university’s own Board of Trustees.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: Corporation aims to boost MSU sports revenue. Should it operate in secret?

title: Whitmer makes ‘science of reading’ training mandatory for Michigan teachers
summary_en: As Michigan struggles with low literacy test scores, leaders are putting in a new training requirement for elementary teachers.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Whitmer makes ‘science of reading’ training mandatory for Michigan teachers

title: Whitmer signs education budget: What to know about college affordability

author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Whitmer signs education budget: What to know about college affordability
